map.某公司期末应收账款 500 万元，年度营业收入 6000 万元，DSO=500÷: A company has ending accounts receivable of 500 (10k CNY) and annual revenue of 6000 (10k CNY), so DSO = 500 ÷ (6000/365) = 500 ÷ 16.44 ≈ 30.4 days - sales are collected in about 30 days on average.
map.DSO 越低越好吗？: Is a lower DSO always better?
map.通常越低回款越快、坏账风险越小，但过严的信用政策可能流失客户；应结合行业惯例与销: Generally, the lower the DSO the faster the collection and the smaller the bad-debt risk, but overly strict credit policy can drive customers away; balance it against industry norms and sales growth targets.
map.为什么用营业收入而不是赊销额？: Why use revenue rather than credit sales?
map.对外财报通常只有营业收入，故用其近似；若赊销占比低，DSO 会被低估，内部分析应: Public financial statements usually report only revenue, so it is used as an approximation; if credit sales are a small share, DSO is understated, and internal analysis should use net credit sales where possible.
map.应收账款周转天数：DSO = 应收账款 ÷ 营业收入 × 365（天）；联动量：: Days sales outstanding: DSO = accounts receivable ÷ operating revenue × 365 (days); linked values: turnover = revenue ÷ max(receivables,1) (times/year), receivables as a share of revenue = receivables ÷ max(revenue,1), equivalent months = DSO ÷ 30. Validation: both fields required (a zero denominator falls back to 1). Rule: no fixed grading; a longer DSO means slower collection.
